purpose: Quantify the direct Pionex public Kline request envelope for the existing 4H/60M/15M strategy inputs. This proposal does not prove provider capacity, account allowance, complete data availability, or zero-cost operation.

assumptions.call_formula_assumption: One request per symbol and interval; batch support is unverified.

derivation.technical_v0_2_ready: EMA200 is the longest required indicator; the full ready_v0_2 snapshot is first computable with 200 closed contiguous candles.
derivation.market_structure_range: The default 20-bar prior range becomes available at index 20, requiring 21 bars including the current candle.
derivation.market_regime: The configured 20-bar return lookback becomes available at index 20, requiring 21 aligned context observations; breadth EMA20 is ready by then.

requests.formula: 3 shared market calls + 23 fixed breadth klines + 5 candidate 60M klines + 5 candidate 15M klines
requests.feasibility_note: 3 shared market calls + 23 fixed breadth Kline calls = 26 requests before any candidate-timeframe candles; reducing candidate_limit alone cannot fit the current 18-request/run ceiling.

comparison_with_v0_1.required_action: A separately reviewed successor budget and complete shared-provider allowance evidence are required before any external request.

unresolved_evidence: Pionex aggregate account request allowance and rate-limit capacity
Shared market endpoint weights and batch Kline support
Whether the 23-market fixed breadth set is complete and continuously available
Strategy-specific warmup requirements beyond the code-derived minima
Shared account-wide request use by other provider workflows
Approved freshness tolerance and safe handling for delayed 15M entry slots
D1/R2 costs if any cross-run cache is proposed
TOTAL3 and BTC dominance source definition, terms, retention rights, and freshness
